name: jobhunt.approach
description: Jobhunt 0-10 macro routing: company-first versus job-first per target, plus the daily floor and the daily learning loop. state = the target's profile (band, fit, contact status, live req) and the day's own ledger. Answers the question of which approach wins for this target, then holds the day to a floor.

k1_track_routing.instructions: Which track this target should get this week

criteria.company_first: Build the relationship and express evergreen interest now; apply when a role matures
criteria.job_first: Apply to the live requisition now and run the standard packet
criteria.both: Do both: apply now and start the relationship in parallel
criteria.ignore: Neither: skip this target this week and say why

k2_daily_floor_held.instructions: Whether the day held the minimums without dropping pay or integrity gates
criteria: 0: zero applications and zero touches
2: touches only, no applications
3: one application and a few touches, gates skipped
4: the floor was attempted but pay or fit gates were skipped to hit it
5: three applications prepared and ten company touches, with pay, fit and dedupe gates intact
6: 5's level plus the batch was ordered by fit, band and reuse
7: 6's level plus nothing below a 5 on lane fit was prepared at all
8: 7's level plus one hiring-manager message went out under the human-send rule
9: 8's level plus one new target entered the company list
10: 9's level plus the day's work is reproducible from the ledger with no unexplained gaps

k3_learning_applied.instructions: Whether the day produced one reversible improvement and recorded it
criteria: 0: nothing was learned or recorded
2: an action with no rollback
3: a change with no test
4: a change tested against one good input only
5: one evidence-backed reversible change with a rollback and a recorded result
6: 5's level plus a known-good and a planted-failure check both ran
7: 6's level plus the change is written where the next run will read it
8: 7's level plus the change names the metric it is supposed to move
9: 8's level plus that metric is checked the next day
10: 9's level plus the loop has now moved a real funnel number

rules.reason: the daily floor was missed or was met by weakening pay, fit or integrity gates
no reversible improvement was recorded today; the loop is not learning

notes: A score that only informs is a dashboard: k1 must choose a track, k2 must name what to do tomorrow, k3 must name what changed. Volume goals never justify skipping f1 base-pay verification or f5 dedupe. Advisory while calibrated:false. SCALE CORRECTION 2026-09-22: the live Jev API hard-caps score levels at 10 ("Too many score levels. Must have at most 10 levels"), contradicting the typesafe-jev skill doc which claims max 11. This pack therefore carries 10 levels labelled 0,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10: the single "just above 0" filler rung was removed and every anchor label and body kept verbatim, so 0 = bad, 5 = average and 10 = world class still hold and rule thresholds (5.0) are unchanged. Operating goal is 9.5 on the 0-10 label scale. If the returned mean proves index-based (max 8 over 10 rungs) rather than label-based, the equivalent goal is 8.55 and the next run must say so rather than rescale silently.
